# Hook (¶1) — fact-only checklist for author-written draft

**Date:** 2026-05-07
**Purpose:** factual scaffold for user-written Hook ¶1. **NO Hook prose generated by Claude.** No English sentence drafts. No rhetorical phrasing. Only the factual ingredients + structural labels + post-draft audit checklist.

---

## 1. Hook 의 목적 (4-sentence framing)

| Sentence | 역할 |
|---|---|
| S1 | 임상 risk gap — RAI 실패 인지 시간 지연 + 분자적 위험 측정 도구 부재 |
| S2 | canonical driver framework (BRAF / RAS / TERT mutation panel) 의 한계 — 분화도 axis 와 직교 |
| S3 | RAI-lineage failure biology gap — system-wide lineage silencing 의 임상 측정 현재 없음 |
| S4 | this paper defines / evaluates a compact RAI-lineage transcriptomic readout for the differentiation axis |

(★ Hook 문단 자체는 author 가 직접 작성)

## 2. Hook 에 넣어도 되는 표현

- thyroid-lineage differentiation axis
- compact RAI-lineage readout
- candidate triage scaffold
- hypothesis only / hypothesis-generating
- complementary to ATA / RAI workflow
- driver-orthogonal
- direction-consistent lineage silencing
- system-wide lineage collapse
- East-Asian generalizability (TCGA + Korean K2 + Lee 2024)
- mechanism support (HM450 + lineage TF backbone)
- consistent with / supports
- prospective validation required
- future-work hypothesis

## 3. Hook 에 넣으면 안 되는 표현

- validated predictor
- predicts RAI response
- treatment selection
- treatment recommendation
- skip RAI
- replace RAI
- direct hemato-oncology referral
- clinical utility proven
- prospective utility
- TROP2 (any TROP2 mention in Hook ¶1)
- H&E inferable / WSI-validated / pathology DM1
- Paper 2 HLA / Hashimoto
- Paper 3 ICI immunotherapy
- Paper 9 synthetic lethality
- decitabine (any decitabine mention in Hook ¶1)
- selpercatinib (any selpercatinib mention in Hook ¶1)
- 5만원 / low-cost test
- Cancer Cell-ready / Nat Cancer reach / venue probability
- all risks resolved

## 4. Safe 4-sentence structure (label only)

```
S1  [clinical risk gap]
    → 갑상선암 수술 후 RAI 표준치료 환자 일부에서 RAI 실패 인지 지연이 임상 unmet need
S2  [canonical driver framework limitation]
    → BRAF V600E / RAS / TERT mutation panel 만으론 분화도 axis 정의 불가 (mRNA d=−0.04 NS)
S3  [RAI-lineage biology gap]
    → 분화도 침묵 자체를 임상에 deploy 가능한 형태로 측정하는 도구 부재
S4  [this paper aims]
    → compact RAI-lineage transcriptomic readout 정의 + 외부 cohort 평가 + mechanism support
```

## 6. After-draft audit checklist (Hook 작성 후 Claude 에게 audit 요청)

Hook 1 paragraph 작성 후 Claude 에게 *문장 재작성 없이* 다음만 audit 요청:

- [ ] **factual accuracy** — number / claim 이 source 와 일치하는가
- [ ] **overclaim** — affirmative validated / treatment / clinical utility / TROP2 / H&E / decitabine 등 banned 표현 사용 여부
- [ ] **scope contamination** — Paper 2 (HLA/HT) / Paper 3 (ICI) / Paper 9 (SL) 영역 침범 여부
- [ ] **citation risk** — Krishnamoorthy 2025 misattribution → Landa 2016 cite-save 일관성 (Discussion §3.1 framing 과 충돌 안 하는지)
- [ ] **voice consistency** — author 의 다른 voice-protected sections (Aim / Limitations / Cover) 와 톤 일관
